title: 問得無聊，答得滑稽
titleEn: Ask a Silly Question and You Get a Silly Answer
imageAlt: Illustrated learning card for Ask a Silly Question and You Get a Silly Answer.
imageAltZh: 「問得無聊，答得滑稽」學習插圖。

source.reference: Oxford proverb index; original teaching scenes and questions

meaning.en: An obvious, absurd, or poorly thought-out question may invite an equally flippant reply.
meaning.zh: 問題太顯而易見、荒謬或沒有想清楚時，對方可能用玩笑式答案回應。

formulas.formula: ask a silly question and you get a silly answer
formulas.highlight: ask a silly question and you get a silly answer

examples.en: Ken had paint on both hands. Asked whether he had painted the wall, he joked that he had shaken hands with a paint tin: ask a silly question and you get a silly answer.
examples.zh: 阿謙滿手油漆，朋友卻問他是否剛畫過牆；他笑說自己剛和油漆桶握手。
examples.highlight: ask a silly question and you get a silly answer

instructions.en: Choose the one sentence that keeps the situation’s facts and uses “ask a silly question and you get a silly answer” accurately.
instructions.zh: 選出唯一保留情境事實、又正確使用「ask a silly question and you get a silly answer」的英文句子。
